meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求处理 Git 提交或查历史时，Claude 会先检查仓库状态，再按提交、重写历史、查历史、看状态四种类型行动。它会做原子提交、按仓库风格写提交信息，并在改写历史前做安全检查。
howto.when: 当你说要提交代码改动、问某段代码是谁或何时加的、或要求压缩/重排提交历史时触发。普通代码编辑不会触发。

say.text: 帮我把这些改动分成几个原子提交
say.note: Claude 会按模块分组并逐个提交

say.text: 查一下第 42 行是谁写的，哪次提交引入的
say.note: 它会执行 git blame 并说明证据

say.text: 把最近三个提交压缩成一个，并保留原信息
say.note: 会用 rebase 安全重写历史

howto.what_en: When you ask for Git commits or history investigation, Claude first inspects the repo state, then acts according to the operation type (commit, rewrite, history, status). It creates atomic commits, matches the repo's message style, and performs safety checks before rewriting history.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a task involves committing code or Git-history questions, such as requesting a commit, asking who/when changed a line, or squashing/reordering commits. Ordinary code edits do not trigger it.

say_en.text: Split these changes into several atomic commits.
say_en.note: Claude groups and commits by module.

say_en.text: Find who wrote line 42 and which commit introduced it.
say_en.note: It runs git blame and shows evidence.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one, keeping the message.
say_en.note: Uses rebase to safely rewrite history.
